title: JOYOR S8-Z All-terrain Electric Scooter
sellingPoints: With turn signal function, improve driving safety

details.title: 600w Brushless Motor
details.content: Joyor S8 features a 600W electric motor for powerful acceleration, large wheels, and swingarm suspension for a smooth ride on any terrain. Its aerospace-grade aluminum frame is lightweight yet durable. The 600W brushless motor provides strong power.

details.title: 90km Runner
details.content: Whether commuting, going to work, or leisurely strolling, the 48V26ah,1248wh large battery ensures you the freedom to move around effortlessly.

details.title: Rocker arm high-elasticitysuspension system
details.content: Equipped with a patented damping suspension system,allowing you to travel smoothly as if on flat ground while also enjoying an attractive visual experience.

details.title: Foldable and portable
details.content: The S5 electric scooter has an unfolded size of 1215*610*1230mm and a folded size of 1120*610*525mm. It weighs 26.7kg and is easy to transport and store. It is an ideal choice for commuting to school, work or short trips.
The scooter features a smart LCD showing speed, mode, battery, and lighting.
6 Light System with front headlights, rear taillights, and turning indicators for all-around illumination.

moreDetails.caption: Front and rear disc brakes provide stable braking performance even at high speeds
10inch widen tire Upgrade your ride with the durable and reliable 10-inch widen tire.
